about_the_game:
Rap Simulator – Dive into the golden era of hip-hop!

Enter the world of Rap Simulator, a humorous simulation game set in the wild 1980s, where dreams of a music career collide with the harsh reality of street life. You play as an ambitious rapper starting from nothing, building your very first studio in a rented apartment. Your goal is to gain fame, rise from the underground, and dominate the mainstream — but the road to success is filled with choices that can change the course of hip-hop history!

How far will you go?

Every decision you make affects your career. Will you choose a path full of conflicts, illegal deals, and gang wars, or will you focus on music and build your empire on solid foundations? Your success depends on smart budget management and strategic investments in equipment, staff, and marketing.

With every step, you’ll face new challenges — rising fan expectations, adapting to changing music trends, and industry reviews of your productions. Whether you become a rap icon depends on how well you handle the pressure.

Rewrite the history of hip-hop

Your decisions can literally rewrite history. Throughout the game, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with virtual rap legends — or engage in intense conflicts that reshape the dynamics of the hip-hop scene in this fictional world. From rivalries to joint recordings, you decide who stands by your side and who becomes your enemy. The game loosely references real hip-hop culture and trends, but all characters, events, and situations are purely fictional. Create new trends and gain influence that will be forever remembered in virtual history.

From underground to the global stage

Start as an unknown artist with a small studio, but as you progress, you’ll expand your operations — move into larger spaces, hire professional producers and musicians, and invest in cutting-edge studio technology. Your tracks will be reviewed by industry media and the community, and your reputation will grow with every success.

Create, customize, discover

With an advanced character editor, you have full freedom to create your own rapper and interact with NPCs. Design unique characters, customize their appearance, personality, and musical style. Discover new technologies, solutions, and musical themes that allow you to constantly evolve as an artist.

Reach the top – Build your empire

Music is just the beginning. Create your own clothing brand, open a record label, and grow as a true businessman. Every aspect of your activity can bring you closer to becoming the greatest rap icon of all time.

Key features:

  • Start in the 1980s: Experience the golden era of hip-hop and feel the underground vibe

  • Character editor: Create your own characters, modify NPCs, and shape their music careers

  • Shape history: Influence hip-hop history through collaborations or conflicts with virtual legends

  • Progress & evolve: Discover new technologies, trends, and innovations in the music industry

  • Studio management: Move into larger spaces, hire staff, and invest in better equipment

  • Unlock secrets: Gain access to hidden characters, events, and features

  • Radio boombox: Choose your own rap radio station or play your own tracks

  • Multiplayer mode: Compete with other players or collaborate to create a new era of hip-hop

  • This is war: Diss tracks, gangs, shootouts, ganja, women, drugs, police, and the FBI are part of everyday life in Rap Simulator

  • Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud, gamepad support, Steam Leaderboards

  • And much more...

Rap Simulator is more than just a music game — it’s your chance to take control of hip-hop culture, from underground beginnings to global domination. Which path will you choose? Will you become a living legend, or will your name be remembered as an icon who rose too fast and fell too early?
